description:
**Armed `check:api` failure — the same defect MRQ-59 just fixed for uploads, in a worse place.**

Found while verifying MRQ-59. `src/routes/auth.endpoints.ts` and `src/routes/admin-ops.endpoints.ts` are raw Hono sub-apps mounted directly in `src/index.ts` (`app.route("/api/v1/admin", adminOpsRoutes)` and equivalent). They are named `*.endpoints.ts`, so `_manifest.ts`'s `import.meta.glob("./**/*.routes.ts")` never sees them, and their paths are absent from the generated manifest and the served OpenAPI document.

**Why this is worse than the uploads case:** `check:api` replays a full-loop e2e session, collects every non-GET request, and fails on any path missing from the public schema. **Walkthrough step 1 is a one-click demo login** — a POST to `/api/v1/auth/demo`. So the very first action of the judges' loop is an unregistered non-GET path. The moment e2e drives the real loop, `check:api` fails, and it will look like a regression in whichever ticket happens to add that e2e coverage.

Scope:
- Bring `auth` and `admin-ops` into the manifest convention (`*.routes.ts`, registered through the manifest like every other API module), or — if these genuinely must stay raw Hono sub-apps for cookie/session reasons — add them to an **explicit named allowlist** beside SPEC §4.2's three calendar/feed URLs, with a comment saying why.
- Either way the decision must be *recorded*, not implied by a filename.
- Confirm the served OpenAPI then contains the auth and admin paths (or that the allowlist covers them), and that `check:api` passes against an e2e run that performs a demo login.
- **Do not weaken MRQ-3's guardrail tests to make this easier.** AC-2 (demo login 403s outside `demo_mode`, no cookie set) and AC-214 (per-event reviewer scope, incl. the schema CHECK) must all still pass unchanged.

Note the fleet-wide pattern this is the second instance of: a module named outside the glob passes its own tests and arms a failure for someone else. The convention is in `.lattice/orchestration/boot/COMMON.md`.

Depends on: MRQ-3 (merged), MRQ-59 (merged), MRQ-60 (merged). Hours: ~2. Workflow: inline-full. Guardrail-adjacent — orchestrator hand-review at merge.
title: Register auth and admin-ops routes in the API manifest
